name: Riveter
summary: Riveter's AI web data API: scrape a page, quick web search, one-off research answers, and the results of enrichment runs.

api_key.description: A Riveter API key (app.riveterhq.com/settings/api). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

notes: Everything is billed in credits. Most kickoff endpoints take estimate_cost (price without running) and max_credits (refuse above a ceiling).

scrape and quick_search answer synchronously. search_agent holds up to 50 s; enrich and other kickoffs return a run (run_...): poll runs.get (pending, enqueued, processing, success, stopped) every 10-20 s or long-poll runs.result with wait, or pass webhook_url.
Datasets, saved enrichments, extractions and monitors are not in this entry. Verb-style legacy paths (/run_new_enrichment, /run_status...) still answer but are deprecated.

endpoints.name: Scrape a page
endpoints.summary: A web page's text content, synchronously.

proxy_country_code.description: Two-letter proxy country, e.g. us, gb, de.

skip_cache.description: Always fetch fresh content. Default false.

estimate_cost.description: Price the request without running or charging it. Default false.

max_credits.description: Credit ceiling; a request whose estimate exceeds it is refused with 422 and costs nothing.

notes: A read over POST. The answer uses the legacy request_status format.

endpoints.name: Quick web search
endpoints.summary: Web results with URLs, titles and snippets, synchronously, optionally within a date range.

date_end.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD; today when only date_start is set.

run_key.description: Idempotency key; becomes the run id run_<key>.

estimate_cost.description: Price the request without running or charging it. Default false.

max_credits.description: Credit ceiling; a request whose estimate exceeds it is refused with 422 and costs nothing.

notes: A read over POST. The answer is a run with the results already in output.

endpoints.name: Ask a research question
endpoints.summary: One AI-researched answer to a scoped question (e.g. a company's NAICS code), optionally shaped by a JSON Schema.

prompt.example: What is the NAICS code for Stripe?

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the answer; output.result then follows it.

wait.description: Seconds to hold for the answer (default and max 50); 0 returns at once to poll runs.result.

run_key.description: Idempotency key; becomes the run id run_<key>.

estimate_cost.description: Price the request without running or charging it. Default false.

max_credits.description: Credit ceiling; a request whose estimate exceeds it is refused with 422 and costs nothing.

notes: A read over POST. For many rows or complex research use enrich.

endpoints.name: Get run result
endpoints.summary: The run with its output; output is null until it finishes.

endpoints.name: Get account
endpoints.summary: Plan, credit balance and the key's metadata.
